worldcombat.skill.spinout.summary: Drops its weight low, grinds sparks off the ground and spins flat across the distance into the target: the hit deals a heavy single blow and knocks the target back, scuffing a ring into the ground at the impact point, while the spin cannot be stopped and harshly lowers the user's Speed by 2 stages. The preload form winds up in place first, charging farther and harder at the cost of a longer wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.spinout.use.0: Spin flat into one target for a heavy single blow
worldcombat.skill.spinout.use.1: Knock a target off position and spin on to the next
worldcombat.skill.spinout.use.2: Trade the heaviest self-slowing for a key target
worldcombat.skill.spinout.description.0: The spinning charge strikes the target for %1$s physical damage; charge range %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.spinout.description.1: A hit knocks the target %1$s blocks and lowers the user's Speed %2$s stage(s).
worldcombat.skill.spinout.preload.on: Preload form: winds up in place first; charge range x1.2, charge speed x1.15, power x1.1 and denser sparks; costs wind-up +4 ticks, recovery +2 ticks, cooldown +8 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.spinout.preload.off: Instant form: spins the moment the legs load, a fast, short-cooldown cast, but charges less far and hits lighter.
worldcombat.skill.spinout.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.spinout.growth.0: From level %1$s the strike power rises to %2$s and the knock-back to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.spinout.growth.1: From level %1$s the strike power rises to %2$s and the charge range to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.spinout.preference.pre: On: winds up in place first; charge range x1.2, charge speed x1.15, power x1.1 and denser sparks; costs wind-up +4 ticks, recovery +2 ticks, cooldown +8 ticks. Off (instant): spins as soon as the legs load, fast with a short cooldown, but charges less far and hits lighter.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger opens the charge from farther, but it is easier to sidestep mid-charge.
On: low-health targets rank higher so one heavy moving blow finishes them and the slow-down is spent settling the fight; off: all targets score the same.
